searchText: Hey channel! Are we going to make Gossip v1.1 a part of the spec v.0.12 ? <@!425567222635954178> already happened, I believe https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/1796 <@!144468805697929216> Ok, thanks! Missed it cause the protocol version wasn't changed in the spec `/meshsub/1.0.0` Shouldn't it also be upgraded to `/meshsub/1.1.0`? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md#the-gossip-domain-gossipsub <@!425567222635954178> I couldn't find the protocol version changing in the gossipsub specs so I didn't bump it. I think the reason it doesn't change is that v1.1 is fully backwards compatible with v1.0 (and even floodsub!) <@!291925846556540928> it's specified in the overview section https://github.com/libp2p/specs/blob/master/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub-v1.1.md#overview > Peers that implement these extensions, advertise v1.1 of the protocol using /meshsub/1.1.0 as the protocol string. oh whoops! thanks <@!425572898787426305> and <@!425567222635954178> for pointing that out

excerpts.author: nashatyrev
excerpts.content: Hey channel! Are we going to make Gossip v1.1 a part of the spec v.0.12 ?

excerpts.author: nashatyrev
excerpts.content:
<@!144468805697929216> Ok, thanks! Missed it cause the protocol version wasn't changed in the spec `/meshsub/1.0.0` 
Shouldn't it also be upgraded to `/meshsub/1.1.0`?
https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md#the-gossip-domain-gossipsub

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: <@!425567222635954178> I couldn't find the protocol version changing in the gossipsub specs so I didn't bump it. I think the reason it doesn't change is that v1.1 is fully backwards compatible with v1.0 (and even floodsub!)

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: <@!291925846556540928> it's specified in the overview section https://github.com/libp2p/specs/blob/master/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub-v1.1.md#overview

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: > Peers that implement these extensions, advertise v1.1 of the protocol using /meshsub/1.1.0 as the protocol string.
